title: [Bug] - Bolus Wizard does not correctly display negative units
symptom: In the Bolus Wizard/Calculator, positive IOB is displayed as a positive number instead of a negative number that should be deducted from the calculated dose. Additionally, any negative number in the right column causes the 'U' after the figure to wrap to the next line, and the bottom of the U is truncated.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify a root cause for the sign change; it is a regression from version 3.2.0.4 to 3.3.1.3. The wrapping issue is attributed to the user's larger font size on their device.
fix: The fix for the sign issue was merged in PR #3831, which corrected the math notation to show negative numbers with a minus sign. For the wrapping issue, reducing the character size on the phone makes the 'U' fit on the same line.
evidence_quote: I focused on getting correct math notation in wizard calc log so when you sum them all up it will be the bolus you will administer in the end.
